name: How long does it take to coordinate a flooring installation project?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to coordinate a flooring installation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for flooring installation coordination depends on several factors, including the size of your project, the type of flooring selected, and our current scheduling. Typically, initial consultations and material selection can take a few days to a week. Installation itself can range from a few days for smaller rooms to several weeks for larger, more complex projects. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Coordination time varies by project size, flooring type, and schedule; we provide a detailed timeline after assessment.
